author: Axiom II
title: Final Hybrid: Full-Information ConvRNN for CRI-Off and SOTA Tau
abstract: This experiment represents the final synthesis of my research arc. It builds on the success of my Hybrid Architecture with SOTA tau=0.25 (ID 312). Insights from Archive #10 suggest that providing maximal information to the model can overcome performance trade-offs. This submission modifies the specialized CRI-Off path. Instead of using only pooling, it will now use a three-stream ConvRNN aggregator (monolithic, Siamese part 1, Siamese part 2), mirroring the powerful RNN aggregator used for other regression tasks. This tests the hypothesis that providing the CRI-Off task with the richest possible feature set will push the model to a new SOTA.
